text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: resumptive-consequential particle linking the reward statement to the preceding warning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby relative pronoun referenced in this word's prose (22:50:2)

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) launches the ayah as consequence and detail after the preceding warning: the reward statement answers the warning role rather than beginning a detached maxim. Its bound placement before {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the bridge attach directly to the class that will be defined by belief and work.

topics.headline: consequence after warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward clause is an answer to the warning in 22:49, not an isolated reward slogan.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as resumptive or consequential, and the boundary rows tie 22:50 back to the warning declaration in 22:49.

topics.headline: bound onset into class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the connective is not free-standing; it is fused to the relative class marker that follows.
topics.reason: The local surface is a bound particle before the relative pronoun, so the consequential bridge and class frame arrive together.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun forming an identifiable action-defined subject class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the recipients a definite but action-defined class: no prior noun names them, so the following relative clause supplies their identity. The predicate waits until belief and sound deeds have been named, making qualification precede allocation.

topics.headline: action-defined relative class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is identifiable through the actions that follow, not through a pre-named social label.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the relative pronoun as the nominal topic whose defining clause runs through words 3-6.

topics.headline: qualification before allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the reward withheld syntactically until the belief-work qualification is complete.
topics.reason: The attachment profile marks words 2-6 as the relative topic before the predicate, and translation support flags this as a repeated reward-category formula anchored at 22:14.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural belief or trust response, locally intransitive with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, safe-conduct, belief, and entrustedness; local grammar selects objectless Form IV belief-response while allowing security and trust pressure to remain audible

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby relative pronoun referenced in this word's prose (22:50:2)

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the relative class its first content mark as a completed plural response. The Form IV, objectless surface keeps belief, trust, and security gathered without naming a specific object, while the shared plural ending ties the act back to {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}). As part of the familiar belief-work formula, it joins same-surah reward passages (22:14, 22:23, 22:56) before this ayah condenses the payoff into forgiveness and noble provision.

topics.headline: completed plural response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the warned audience re-sorted into a response-class whose belief is already grammatically complete.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect 3mp verb, and attachment evidence keeps the plural subject morphologically present but recovered from the relative head.

topics.headline: objectless security-trust field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is not reduced to bare assent; the objectless Form IV lets trust and entry into security pressure the verb while the local sense remains belief-response.
topics.reason: The local frame is explicitly intransitive and V4 lacks this root, so derivative safe-conduct and deposit imagery can color the selected verb but cannot replace its local belief-response function.

topics.headline: belief-work reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this verb to the repeated Quranic and same-surah formula that binds belief to work before reward.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give broad formula evidence and concrete same-surah witnesses, while attachment support identifies the construction as a repeated reward-category refrain.

topics.headline: audible form marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first content verb open with a decisive onset and lengthened vowel before the work verb follows.
topics.reason: The sound-shape observations are local surface observations and support the verb's prominence without adding a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two defining verbs under one relative subject
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the second verb to the same relative subject, so work is not a separate group's feature or a subordinate gloss on belief. The bound connector keeps two predicates distinct while making them one qualification frame.

topics.headline: shared-subject coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief and work are coordinated for the same group, with neither predicate collapsing into the other.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the two verbs as conjoined within the relative clause under one subject.

topics.headline: bound continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second predicate enter as an attached continuation rather than a fresh sentence.
topics.reason: The surface conjunction is bound to the following verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural doing or working, locally transitive with the sound deeds as explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: intentional work, productive action, exertion, operation, appointment, wage, and other work-related branches; local grammar selects direct purposeful action with an explicit object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby object phrase referenced in this word's prose (22:50:6)
later reward noun referenced in this word's prose (22:50:11)

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) completes the subject's qualification with accomplished productive action, not undefined activity. Its transitive frame takes {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) as object, so the work is directed toward sound or restorative deeds; yet the later {{ar:رِزْقٌ}} ({{tr:rizqun}}) keeps the outcome a given provision rather than a wage. The same work-deeds formula links this reward scene with 22:14, 22:23, and 22:56, and it contrasts with hostile striving in 22:51.

topics.headline: completed shared work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same plural class carry work as an accomplished defining pattern alongside belief.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect 3mp verb, and attachment evidence recovers the same plural subject as the belief verb.

topics.headline: productive action with object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is channeled into a specific object, so the action has a morally shaped product rather than floating as effort.
topics.reason: The direct object relation is syntactically forced, and V4 supports intentional doing as the locally relevant branch while excluding unrelated work branches.

topics.headline: agency before gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human agency is preserved, but the later reward is still framed as allocation rather than earned pay.
topics.reason: The work verb supplies agency, while the predicate structure later names gifts allocated to the group.

topics.headline: formula and contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local work-deeds phrase to repeated surah reward scenes and to the immediate contrast with adversarial striving in 22:51.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete same-surah witnesses and the next-ayah contrast, so the echo survives without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine plural active participle used substantively as the direct object: the sound or restorative deeds
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, rightness, repair, reconciliation, suitability, and proper-name branches; local grammar selects the known class of sound deeds as work's object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby governing verb referenced in this word's prose (22:50:5)

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the explicit object of {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}), turning work toward a known plural class of sound deeds. The active participle makes soundness an inherent quality of the acts, while repair and reconciliation imagery narrow into the local category rather than becoming a separate event. The same class marker recurs in reward refrains (22:14, 22:23, 22:56), so the object completes a recognizable belief-work-deeds triad.

topics.headline: known sound-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that work is not generic; it lands on a definite known class of deeds characterized by soundness.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence force the noun as the direct object of the work verb, with definite plural active-participle morphology.

topics.headline: soundness and repair field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears righteousness as sound, reparative action while local grammar keeps it as the deed category, not an independent reconciliation scene.
topics.reason: V4 supports soundness, repair, and reconciliation branches, but the local active-participle noun object selects the sound-deeds category.

topics.headline: formulaic reward marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the object phrase to the repeated reward refrain that identifies the positive response group in the surah.
topics.reason: The rows give same-surah recurrences and formulaic pairing with work language.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition of possession, allocation, or benefit forming the fronted predicate with the pronoun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local prepositional phrase referenced in this word's prose (22:50:7-8)

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the fronted predicate {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), placing benefit and allocation before the gifts are named. Because the preposition is bound to its pronoun, recipienthood is not an afterthought but the frame into which forgiveness and noble provision arrive.

topics.headline: fronted benefactive predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients before the gifts, so the rewards arrive as allocated for them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a preposition of possession or benefit, and attachment support flags the fronted predicate as a construction to preserve.

topics.headline: bound complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees possession and benefit compressed into a bound preposition that requires the attached pronoun.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following pronoun and forms the fronted phrase.

words.gloss_range: third masculine plural pronoun governed by the preceding preposition and routing the reward back to the qualified class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local prepositional phrase referenced in this word's prose (22:50:7-8)

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) closes {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) by routing the reward back to the relative class already defined by belief and sound deeds. The pronoun compresses the whole qualification into a recipient marker, pivoting from who they are to what is allocated for them without using a verbal copula.

topics.headline: qualified recipient pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact pronoun carries the whole previously defined class into the reward predicate.
topics.reason: QAC marks a genitive 3mp pronoun governed by the preposition, and attachment links the phrase to the relative topic.

topics.headline: predicate pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence turn from qualification to allocation through a pronoun phrase rather than through a narrated action.
topics.reason: The nominal sentence predicate is the fronted prepositional phrase, which shifts from the previous warning address to the third-person recipient group.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative gerund naming forgiveness as the first delayed subject and first allocated gift
words.root_gloss_range: protective covering, forgiveness and shielding from consequence, surface nap, relapse, animal names, lunar mansion, tree exudate, crowd idiom, and proper-name material; local grammar selects forgiveness as protective covering-over

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local prepositional phrase referenced in this word's prose (22:50:7-8)

words.prose: {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}) is the first delayed nominative gift after {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}), so forgiveness is allocated to the qualified group before provision is added. The root's covering image and the mīm-gerund form make forgiveness feel like an enacted protective covering-over, while the indefinite ending leaves the gift open rather than measured. This same root returns in the surah at 22:60, moving from the allocated covering here to the forgiving attribute there.

topics.headline: first allocated gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forgiveness as the first named gift in the fronted allocation frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as an indefinite nominative delayed subject predicated with the fronted phrase.

topics.headline: protective covering process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels forgiveness as a protective covering-over, while local reward grammar keeps it from becoming a literal helmet or material cover.
topics.reason: V4 supports covering and forgiveness branches; the local gerund and reward context select forgiveness while preserving the protective covering image.

topics.headline: indefinite process form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forgiveness as an open-ended granted process rather than a counted or requested item.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite nominative and a gerund; occurrence evidence marks the mīm-gerund surface as distributionally notable within the root family.

topics.headline: reward pair and echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this first gift to the paired noble provision and to the later same-root return at 22:60.
topics.reason: The rows connect the local reward pair and give the concrete same-surah echo at 22:60.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining provision to forgiveness as a second co-equal reward noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby first reward noun referenced in this word's prose (22:50:9)
nearby second reward noun referenced in this word's prose (22:50:11)

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:رِزْقٌ}} ({{tr:rizqun}}) as a second nominative reward beside {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}). The conjunction keeps provision co-equal with forgiveness and makes the reward package two-part: covering over deficit and supplying what is needed.

topics.headline: two-part reward coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as an added co-equal gift, not a gloss on forgiveness.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks provision as conjoined to forgiveness in the same reward predicate.

topics.headline: bound second gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second gift enter the same phrase without opening another clause.
topics.reason: The conjunction is bound to the second reward noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative gerund naming provision as the second allocated reward, modified by the following adjective
words.root_gloss_range: provision as allotted gift, nourishing food, rain as provision, stipends, gratitude/share idiom, fortunate lot, and named cloth or grape terms; local grammar selects allotted provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following adjective referenced in this word's prose (22:50:12)

words.prose: {{ar:رِزْقٌ}} ({{tr:rizqun}}) is the second nominative reward, grammatically parallel to forgiveness and specifically modified by {{ar:كَرِيمٌ}} ({{tr:karīmun}}). Its indefiniteness leaves the provision open in extent, while the root's allocation field makes the workers recipients of a gift rather than wage-earners. In the reward pair, forgiveness removes deficit and provision adds supply; the same provision root belongs to a surah-local motif (22:28, 22:34, 22:35, 22:58).

topics.headline: parallel qualified provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as a co-equal reward noun whose quality is confined to the following adjective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark provision as an indefinite nominative conjoined to forgiveness, with the following adjective modifying it.

topics.headline: open allotted gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees provision as an unmeasured allotment received by the qualified group, not a mechanical earning from their work.
topics.reason: V4 supports allotted provision as the local branch; derivative earning and provided-for imagery sharpen the contrast but do not turn the noun into a wage term.

topics.headline: gerund gift form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun names the provision itself as an allocated thing rather than narrating an act of providing.
topics.reason: The local form is a gerund in a nominal reward list, not a passive verb assigning the recipients as verbal subjects.

topics.headline: reward pair and provision motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees provision expand forgiveness into a complete reward complex and connect to the surah's wider provision language.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the subtraction-plus-addition reward structure and give concrete same-surah provision references.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative qualitative adjective modifying provision: noble, generous, dignifying, or precious
words.root_gloss_range: nobility, generosity, praiseworthy excellence, fertile bounty, necklace, grapevine, vessel cover, rivalry in generosity, valued person or thing, and formulaic honor; local grammar selects qualitative nobility of provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby noun modified by this adjective and referenced in this word's prose (22:50:11)

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمٌ}} ({{tr:karīmun}}) closes the ayah by qualifying {{ar:رِزْقٌ}} ({{tr:rizqun}}) specifically, not the preceding forgiveness. Its indefinite nominative agreement locks the adjective inside the provision phrase, and the faʿīl quality makes the provision noble, generous, and dignifying rather than simply abundant. Because it is the final word, the reward scene lands on quality and dignity; the same high-rank adjective register includes examples such as 56:77 and 23:116, while the same surah also knows a dishonor contrast at 22:18.

topics.headline: modifier scope lock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nobility belongs to provision specifically, not to the whole preceding reward pair.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an adjective agreeing with and modifying provision.

topics.headline: noble quality not quantity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the promised provision by rank and dignity, not merely by amount.
topics.reason: V4 supports nobility and generosity as the local branch, while other branches such as grapevine, necklace, or vessel cover are not activated by the adjective's local grammar.

topics.headline: adjectival form choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word presents stable quality in the provision rather than narrating an event of honoring or naming an independent title.
topics.reason: The local form is an indefinite qualitative adjective, not a verb, passive participle, or definite title form.

topics.headline: closure and high-rank echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close on dignity and can place that closure within a wider high-rank adjective register.
topics.reason: The rows tie final position to qualitative closure and provide concrete high-rank or contrast references.

baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust supplies inward stability, and intentional action converts that stability into repair of corruption and fitting conduct. The coordination does not itself prove causation, but the branch sequence supports this functional movement.

activation_trace.role: The literal image is a heart at rest in safety and trust; it functions as the stable interior condition of the model.
Heart-settling assent supplies the epistemic commitment from which the coordinated conduct proceeds.
Purposive action makes the response enacted rather than merely inward.
Opposition to corruption gives the actions a reparative direction.
Fitness for a thing adds situational aptness, so repair is not reduced to an abstract moral label.

changed_reading.before: A formula saying that believers who do good receive rewards.
changed_reading.after: A compact mechanism in which secure assent becomes purposive, situation-fitting repair.

baseline_models.mechanism: Forgiveness is both treatment of fault and a covering that protects the person from the fault's continuing effect. It therefore reads as remedial preservation, not only deletion from a ledger.

activation_trace.role: A cover that guards what it encloses supplies the protective material image.
Covering the fault and preserving its bearer from the consequence supplies the moral application.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness means that prior faults are cancelled.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness covers the fault in a way that also preserves its bearer from the fault's damaging afterlife.

baseline_models.mechanism: The provision is an apportioned, sustaining benefit whose nobility lies in both its quality and the honorable relation it establishes with its recipient. Quantity alone does not explain كريم.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned gift or benefit supplies the distributive core of the provision.
Food that reaches and sustains the interior keeps the gift materially life-supporting.
Praiseworthy honor and generosity make dignity, not mere abundance, the provision's defining quality.
The image of something held dear adds relational preciousness to what is given.

changed_reading.before: A generous or plentiful reward is assigned to them.
changed_reading.after: They receive sustaining allotment in a form that recognizes and restores honor.

baseline_models.mechanism: The agricultural branches make repair and reward materially continuous: corruption is reversed, rain becomes provision, and good soil or vegetation gives the provision a generative nobility.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the restorative action.
Rain named as provision supplies the life-releasing input.
Good soil, vegetation, and rain supply the image of fruitful quality.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are followed by an unspecified high-quality reward.
changed_reading.after: Reparative deeds and noble provision participate in a regenerative cycle that restores the capacity for life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two rain sequences turn the focus's dormant agricultural branches into a causal ecology: water reaches inert ground, the ground moves, growth emerges, and subtle land-tending culminates in green flourishing. صالحات can consequently be heard as acts that restore generative capacity, while رزق كريم names provision that makes further life possible.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the ecological model in the focus's description of action.
Rain as provision is the focus-side material bridge to the context's water sequences.
Good soil, vegetation, and rain give كريم a fruitful rather than merely prestigious quality.
Water delivered by irrigation supplies the enabling input to dormant earth.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the transition from latency to activity.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the visible product of provision.
Verdure as flourishing and good life makes the outcome more than bare survival.
Fineness and hidden subtlety characterize the unobtrusive process by which the change occurs.
Cultivating or repairing land supplies an explicit material analogy for صالحات.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders inert earth, descending water, movement, increase, growth, and delight as a transformation sequence.
22:63 repeats water-to-green transformation and closes with subtle knowledge, making the process a recurrent frame rather than an isolated image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-driven revival and branches for provision as rain and كريم as fertile goodness; I supply the analogy from land repair to صالحات and from revival to the reward's generativity. A live alternative is that both rain passages serve resurrection proof without specifying 22:50's reward.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a static allotment delivered after good conduct.
changed_reading.after: Noble provision is also a subtle regenerative input, and good conduct is repair that lets latent life become fruitful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The edge-worshipper becomes calm only when favorable experience arrives and reverses when tested. Against that sequence, the focus's faith is durable security that precedes its لهُم outcome: noble provision is not collateral purchasing assent, and losing provision does not logically reverse faith.

activation_trace.role: Settled safety supplies the focus's durable alternative to conditional calm.
The apportioned benefit is positioned as an outcome, not the foundation that makes trust possible.
Literal deviation from a direction gives the edge-position its instability.
The strange image of provision inclining away from its possessor activates economic precarity inside the edge metaphor.
Calm occurs here as a conditionally triggered state rather than settled trust.
Assay of metal or person supplies the pressure that exposes whether the calm is stable.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal produced by the test.

structural_cues: 22:11 uses paired conditions: favorable arrival produces calm, while trial produces inversion.
22:50 orders faith and reparative action before the outcome marked for them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision-sensitive calm, assay, and reversal; I infer that the focus's order rejects a transactional ground for faith. A live alternative is that 22:11 diagnoses hypocrisy without defining the temporal relation between faith and provision in 22:50.

changed_reading.before: Faith and good action are conditions exchanged for favorable provision.
changed_reading.after: Secure faith remains noncontingent under assay; provision follows as gift and cannot be the price that purchases fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier recurrence of the same faith-and-action cohort unfolds its destination as sheltered garden, adornment, clothing, good speech, and a praiseworthy path. رزق كريم thus carries a whole dignity-restoring environment: material beauty and refined orientation coexist rather than competing.

activation_trace.role: Honor and praiseworthy generosity anchor the expansion as dignity rather than luxury alone.
A necklace worn at the neck creates a direct latent bridge to the context's adornment.
A garden sheltered by its vegetation supplies a protected environment for the provision.
Adornment supplies visible honor bestowed on the recipients.
Clothing as a covering makes dignity embodied and protective.
Goodness opposed to corruption extends the gift from objects into speech.
Gentle direction to a path makes orientation itself part of the bestowed provision.

structural_cues: 22:23 repeats the focus's exact cohort formula before detailing its garden and adornment.
22:24 continues the same destination with good speech and a praiseworthy path, joining material and discursive goods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated cohort followed by a bundle of shelter, adornment, clothing, speech, and path; I infer that this bundle can unpack the focus's compressed رزق كريم. A live alternative is that 22:23-24 and 22:50 name parallel rewards without one glossing the other.

changed_reading.before: Noble provision is a high-quality consumable or generic reward.
changed_reading.after: Noble provision is a dignity-restoring habitat that includes beauty, covering, speech, and guided movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated provision language is coupled to eating, feeding, spending, and two socially distinct recipients. The allotment becomes كريم not merely by being possessed but by circulating without stripping dignity from the content recipient or the exposed seeker.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned benefit anchors the model in the focus's provision.
Honor and generosity supply the criterion governing how the benefit circulates.
The provided livestock concretizes the allotted benefit before its distribution.
Feeding another turns provision outward as an enacted transfer.
A renewed occurrence of apportioned provision links receipt directly to expenditure.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the circulation step.
Contentment identifies one recipient without defining that person by lack.
Coming to another as seeker or guest identifies the exposed recipient whom honorable giving must protect.

structural_cues: 22:28 moves from what was provided to the paired imperatives to eat and feed the afflicted poor.
22:35 and 22:36 repeat the movement from received provision to spending or feeding named recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated receipt-to-distribution sequences and recipient distinctions; I infer that كريم qualifies the social manner and circulation of provision as well as the gift itself. A live alternative is that كريم describes only the focus's future reward, while the pilgrimage distributions remain ethical analogies.

changed_reading.before: Provision is an honorable possession assigned to the faithful.
changed_reading.after: Provision becomes noble through dignifying circulation: what reaches them is also learned as something that can reach others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine defense of believers and the later sequence of proportionate response, renewed aggression, help, pardon, and forgiveness prevent مغفرة from becoming passivity. Its covering protects after wrong while measured resistance still names and checks the wrong.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering anchors forgiveness as preservation rather than denial.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer from consequence supplies the explicitly moral sense.
Pushing harm away supplies an active protective boundary around those who believe.
Consequence following offense supplies the measured juridical response.
Transgression beyond the limit marks renewed harm that still requires defense.
Pushing away harm and clothing with safety makes pardon itself protective.
The repeated forgiveness branch closes the retaliation-and-defense sequence with protected remission.

structural_cues: 22:38 explicitly places defense around those who believe.
22:60 preserves the order proportionate response, renewed aggression, promised help, then the paired attributes pardon and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defense, measured consequence, fresh transgression, help, pardon, and forgiveness; I infer that forgiveness can govern the aftermath without erasing protective boundaries. A live alternative is that the closing attributes are general assurances rather than a model of how justice and remission coexist.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness requires foregoing resistance and treating injury as though it did not occur.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is protective remediation compatible with naming aggression, proportionate response, and defense against recurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately adjacent cohort also exerts purposive effort, but its vector runs against the signs in an attempt to outstrip or disable them. عمل الصالحات therefore becomes counter-sway: agency that repairs and fits reality rather than agency mobilized to make disclosure ineffective.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action anchors both cohorts in the common field of directed agency.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the positive vector of the focus cohort.
Purposive movement toward an objective supplies the rival cohort's agency.
Competitive striving sharpens the effort into an adversarial contest.
The visible sign is the disclosed reality against which the rival effort is directed.
Outrunning and escaping pursuit supplies the attempt to place the signs behind or render them unable to catch up.

structural_cues: 22:50 and 22:51 are adjacent, begin with coordinated relative cohorts, and oppose their actions and outcomes.
The focus names عمل صالح, while the next ayah names سعي directed against the signs and qualified by معاجزين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two active cohorts, purposive striving, visible signs, and an outstripping image; I supply the directional arrow that one agency repairs disclosed reality while the other tries to neutralize it. A live alternative is a simpler forensic contrast between obedience and opposition without a shared agency model.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are a positive list opposed to an inactive lack of belief.
changed_reading.after: Good deeds are one direction of active sway, set against equally purposive counter-sway that tries to make the signs ineffective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The casting-removal-establishment sequence is followed by an assay that separates dimmed or hardened hearts from those that recognize truth, believe, and become lowly receptive. Faith in the focus can thus be a post-interference stabilization of the heart, not merely an untested initial assent; the two packet mappings of خبت preserve both receptive lowland and quenched fire as coexisting images.

activation_trace.role: Assent in which the heart finds rest anchors the stabilized reading in the focus.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the filtering operation after alien casting.
Making something firm, exact, and secured supplies the re-stabilization of the signs.
Assaying metal or person makes interference diagnostic rather than merely noisy.
Dimming and loss of clarity describe one heart's impaired reception.
Loss of softness describes the other resistant mode of reception.
Belief follows recognition of truth and settles the heart, explicitly enacting the focus branch in context.
A low, broad, quiet tract supplies the heart's receptive and unresisting posture.
A fire dying down supplies a coexisting image of resistant heat being quenched.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences alien casting, removal, and firm establishment of signs.
22:53-54 explicitly contrast diseased or hardened hearts with knowledge, belief, and a changed heart posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interference, removal, establishment, assay, two failed reception states, recognition, belief, and خبت; I infer a signal-recovery process in the heart. A live alternative is that the sequence classifies audiences without making faith itself a recovery event, and the two خبت images remain analogical rather than lexical conclusions.

changed_reading.before: Faith is a settled qualification already possessed before the ayah's reward clause.
changed_reading.after: Faith can be the heart's recovered stability after interference has exposed, tested, and softened its mode of reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact cohort formula returns inside a scene of sovereign judgment and is immediately opposed to humiliating punishment. كريم therefore marks adjudicated dignity and standing, while the provision is the concrete enjoyment of that status; it is not merely a private quantity of goods.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned benefit supplies the concrete award made in the judgment scene.
Honor supplies the status dimension that directly opposes humiliation.
Sovereign authority establishes the public frame in which outcomes are assigned.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative act behind the distinct outcomes.
Good condition and benefaction give experiential content to the awarded dignity.
Humiliation by contempt supplies the immediate negative counterpart to كريم as honor.

structural_cues: 22:56 places divine sovereignty and judgment before repeating the focus's faith-and-action cohort.
22:57 immediately contrasts that cohort's gardens of enjoyment with a humiliating outcome for the denying cohort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign judgment, repeated cohort wording, enjoyment, and humiliation; I infer that كريم carries publicly restored standing as well as gift quality. A live alternative is that honor and humiliation belong only to the outcomes' affective tone, not a juridical status model.

changed_reading.before: Kريم says only that the provision is excellent or abundant.
changed_reading.after: Kريم names dignity conferred under judgment, with provision as the lived substance of an honorable standing opposed to humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is promised after departure from home and after death, then completed as entry into a place the recipients approve. The focus's noble provision is therefore continuity-bearing welcome: it survives the loss of ordinary supply lines and culminates in satisfying admission.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned gift anchors the promised provision in the focus.
Something treated as dear supplies the relational warmth of welcome.
Leaving one abode for another breaks the ordinary spatial source of livelihood.
Loss of life marks the maximal severance across which the promised provision still operates.
The clustered promise, noun, and provider forms intensify provision as the answer to severance and death.
Goodness opposed to ugliness parallels the focus's كريم while preserving a distinct evaluative term.
Entry into an interior converts provision from an object into reception at a destination.
Approval rather than displeasure makes the destination satisfying to its recipients.

structural_cues: 22:58 places good provision after migration and either killing or death, beyond ordinary acquisition.
22:59 continues the promise with entry into a destination the recipients approve.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, death, repeated provision, evaluative goodness, entry, and approval; I infer that provision functions as hospitality and continuity across death. A live alternative is that provision and entry are consecutive but independent gifts.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a future commodity granted as compensation.
changed_reading.after: Provision is an honorable welcome that crosses displacement and death and becomes satisfying arrival.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it makes the promise sound occupational and potentially transactional. It remains anchored in direct focus branches that pair work with its wage and provision with a troop stipend; downstream prose should call it a lexical labor-economy echo, not reduce divine gift to an employment contract.

activation_trace.role: Wage or livelihood attached to work supplies the compensation frame.
Troop stipends supply the image of a regular allotment to commissioned agents.

changed_reading.before: The provision is wholly outside any work-and-compensation imagery.
changed_reading.after: A contained lexical echo presents the actors as commissioned workers receiving an honorable stipend, without settling the theology as contractual.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is odd because a specialized كريم branch supplies a vessel lid, not the ordinary adjective sense. It remains anchored across the focus's adjacent forgiveness, food-provision, and كريم branches; downstream prose should present it only as a double-cover resonance in which person and sustenance are preserved, never as a lexical translation of كريم.

activation_trace.role: A guarding cover supplies preservation of the recipient.
Food reaching the interior supplies the contained sustenance.
A lid placed over a vessel supplies the second, materially preserving cover.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and provision are two unrelated benefits.
changed_reading.after: A material resonance pairs protective covering of the person with covered preservation of the sustenance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vineyard reading is surprising because the grapevine is a branch image of كريم rather than its expected adjectival force. It remains anchored by the focus's rain-provision and vine branches and by contextual gardens and greening; downstream prose may carry a rain-made vineyard image but must not translate كريم as grapevine or exclude the honor reading.

activation_trace.role: Rain named as provision supplies the vineyard's enabling water.
Grapes and vine supply the outlier's specific crop image.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies the destination in which the vine image can live.
Water delivered from above supplies the context's generative irrigation.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the visible state produced by the rain.

changed_reading.before: Noble provision is an abstract reward with no specific material ecology.
changed_reading.after: A contained image sees the reward as a rain-made garden or vineyard whose fruit embodies ongoing provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet resolves خبت to two materially distant roots: quiet lowland and a fire going out. It remains valid as a context activation of the focus's heart-settling faith, with both mapped roots and the heart occurrence cited; downstream prose should preserve them as coexisting metaphors for receptivity and cooled resistance, not choose either as the exclusive lexical meaning.

activation_trace.role: A heart settled in safety anchors both material metaphors in the focus's faith.
The explicit heart identifies the receiving site whose state changes.
A low, broad, quiet terrain images a heart made receptive and unresisting.
A fire dying down images the cooling of resistant agitation in the same heart.

changed_reading.before: Faith settles the heart in a single abstract sense.
changed_reading.after: Faith can be pictured simultaneously as becoming receptive lowland and as resistant fire going quiet.

strongest_changes: Faith became durable and post-test stabilization rather than calm purchased by favorable provision.
Good action became reparative sway opposed to the adjacent cohort's purposive attempt to outstrip the signs.
Noble provision became distributive, dignity-conferring, judicial, regenerative, and a welcome that crosses displacement and death, with those readings retained side by side.
Forgiveness became protective remediation compatible with measured response and defense rather than passive erasure of boundaries.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact reward formula was repeatedly reopened by exact cohort recurrences, the immediate counter-cohort of 22:51, provision-to-feeding sequences, the casting-and-heart sequence, the honor-versus-humiliation contrast, and the postmortem provision-and-entry sequence. Split and specialized branches preserved material readings that a consensus paraphrase would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal movement from settled trust to reparative action is a reader-supplied functional arrow; the focus grammar coordinates the predicates without explicitly marking that causation.
The garden, adornment, judgment, and entry passages may explicate رزق كريم, or they may remain parallel promises whose relation is only analogical.
The ecological, stipend, lidded-vessel, vineyard, and quenched-fire readings are visibly anchored but branch-distant and require explicit containment.
كريم may qualify the gift's intrinsic quality, the giver's generosity, the recipient's restored status, or all three without the packet forcing a single choice.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Protective covering opens into noble provision.** `ء م ن B001/B002` gives trusting security; `ص ل ح B001` sound action; `غ ف ر B001/B002` protective covering and shielding from consequence; `ر ز ق B001/B002` allotted, nourishing provision; `ك ر م B001/B010` nobility and valued gift. The warning of 22:49 branches immediately into a response-outcome sequence. I infer that forgiveness removes disabling consequence so provision can sustain renewed soundness. Reward reads as both repaired protection and positive nourishment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:58-59 expanded *rizq karīm* beyond ordinary sustenance: provision continues across migration and death and resolves in accepted entry.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Response to warning repairs both backward and forward exposure.** Fixed `ءَامَنُوا` activates `ء م ن:B001` (settled trust), `عَمِلُوا` uses `ع م ل:B001`, and `ٱلصَّالِحَات` uses `ص ل ح:B001`. Their paired outcomes are `غ ف ر:B002` (forgiving and shielding from consequence) and `ر ز ق:B001` (provision as allotted gift), qualified by `ك ر م:B001` (nobility and generosity). `22:49` supplies warning and `22:51` supplies counter-endeavor. The packet gives prior consequence, present work, and future provision; I infer a temporal repair mechanism: harmful residue is covered while viable continuation is supplied. The reward is not one undifferentiated good.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:51` supplies equally strenuous but oppositely directed work, confirming that the fixed soundness lies in orientation rather than exertion alone; `22:52-54` show why the signs remain a viable source of repair.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu yolculukta binek kullanmadan yürüyen kişiler için kalıplı bir topluluk adı olarak verir. İşçi topluluğu ve yolun kendisi bu kapsamda değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam yaya yolcuları adlandıran kalıplı topluluk ifadesidir; el işçileri ve işlek yol anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil kalıplı kullanım verir; tanım yalnız yaya yolcu topluluğu ifadesi için geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Yolculukta binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcuları adlandıran kalıplı topluluk ifadesidir. El işçileri ya da yolun kendisi anlamına gelmez.

facets.statement: Yolculuk eden kişilerin yaya gitmesi ana anlamdır.
Adlandırma kişilere yöneliktir, yolun kendisine veya işçilere değil.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yolculuk sırasında yürüyerek giden kişiler için kalıplı bir adlandırma olarak sınırlar.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, bu topluluk adını binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcularla sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yolculuk eden kişilerin yürüyerek gittiği topluluk bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculuk, yaya gitme ve kişi topluluğu çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıplı topluluk adını açıkça çözmek gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolcu, yaya gitme ve topluluk anlamını korur.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durum olarak kurar; ayrıca bu duruma gelmeyi, bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi ve belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranmayı da kapsar. Geçici çerçeve bu durum, süreç ve ettirgen işlem ayrımlarını doğru biçimde bir arada tutmaktadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kişiler, işler ve şeylerdeki iyi durum ile bu durumu sağlama bu dala girer; kişiler arası uzlaşma, uygunluk ve özel adlar ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimlerdeki iyi ve düzgün olma çekirdeğini, düzeltme türevlerini ve yalnızca belirli yapıda görülen iyi davranma kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durumdur. Bu eksen kişinin ve işin iyi olmasını, bir şeyi düzeltmeyi, yarar sağlayan şeyi, iyi duruma getirmeyi istemeyi ve özel bir yapıda hayvana iyi davranmayı kapsar; insanın iyi yaratılması, bozukluğunun giderilmesi veya iyi sayılması da düzeltmenin farklı gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem durum ve duruma gelme çekirdeğini hem de bozukluğu gidererek iyi duruma getirme işlemini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İyi ve düzgün durum, bu duruma gelme ve bu durumu sağlama ayrımlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, iş veya şeyin bozuk olmayan durumunu ya da bu duruma gelmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi bu duruma getirme işlemini ve özel yapıdaki iyi davranma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir etkenin kişi, iş veya şeydeki bozukluğu gidererek onu iyi duruma getirdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Kendiliğinden iyi durumda olmayı ve özel yapıdaki iyi davranma kullanımını karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kaynakta verilen yönelme yapısının bir hayvana yönelik iyi davranışı anlattığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Dalın genel iyi durum ve düzeltme çekirdeğini temsil etmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayımlanan beş karşılaştırma, dal içi karışmaları, temel karşıtlığı, alanla sınırlı yakın anlamı ve genel iyilikle sınır farkını gösterir; kalan adaylar ya yalnızca örnek, özel alan veya ortak senaryo paylaşır ya da kişi ve yer adı dalları olarak anlamsal çekirdeği kesmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uzaklık ve soğukluğun giderilmesini karşılıklı barışma ve uzlaşmayla açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu kişiler arası sınırı korur ve genel anlamdaki iyi olma ya da bir nesneyi düzeltme anlamını bu dala taşımadığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanlar arasındaki soğukluk, çatışma veya uzaklığın barışmayla giderilmesini kapsar; genel düzgünlük ve nesne onarımı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın kişiler arası barışma çekirdeğine dayanır ve başka dallardaki genel iyi olma, düzeltme veya uygunluk anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluk, uzaklık veya çatışmanın giderilerek tarafların karşılıklı biçimde barışması ve uzlaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı insanların kendi aralarında barışması ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir; ad ve eylem biçimleri aynı karşılıklı uzlaşma olayını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluğun veya çatışmanın giderilip karşılıklı barışın kurulmasını eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiler arası olumsuz ilişkinin giderilmesini ve tarafların karşılıklı uzlaşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış tarafların yeniden iyi ilişki kurduğu bağlamlarda doğal bir açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki olumsuz ilişkiyi, bunun giderilmesini ve karşılıklı barışmayı birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: barışma, uzlaşma ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşılıklı barışma anlamında tek yönlüdür; komşu dal ise bir etkenin ilişkiyi barış ya da düşmanlık yönünde kurmasını içeren daha geniş ve ettirgen bir çerçevedir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarafların birbirinden yüz çevirmesi, ilişkiyi kesmesi ve uzaklaşması komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişiler arasındaki yakınlık veya uzaklık durumunu ve ilişkinin sürmesini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzaklığı gidererek ilişkiyi yeniden kurar; komşu dal ilişkiyi keserek tarafları birbirinden uzaklaştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin veya durumun bir kişiye uygun düşmesini ve kişiye yakışmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Olumlu ya da olumsuz tanıklık farkı anlam sınırı kurmaz; iki dal kişiye uygunluk çekirdeğinde aynı kapsamı paylaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin tek bir kişiye uygun düşmesi odak dalın zorunlu ilişkisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki şeyin birbirine uyması ve tarafların düşünce veya işte aynı yönde birleşmesi komşu dalın daha geniş alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal öğeler arasında bağdaşma, uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal şeyden kişiye yönelen uygunluğu anlatır; komşu dal karşılıklı uyumu ve insanlar arasındaki anlaşmayı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin kişinin alanına veya durumuna uygun olması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin ihtiyacı karşılaması, yetmesi veya başka bir şeyin yerini tutması komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şey hem uygun hem de işe yarar olduğunda iki değerlendirme aynı bağlamda bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Uygun olmak, kişi ile şey arasındaki bağdaşmayı bildirir; yeterli olmak ise miktar, işlev veya ihtiyacı karşılama ölçütüne dayanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uyması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişi, iş veya şeyin kendi başına iyi ve düzgün olması ya da düzeltilmesi komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kişiye uygunluk ve kendi başına düzgünlük
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şey hakkında olumlu bir değerlendirme bildirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkisel ve kalıba bağlıdır; komşu dal ise şeyin içsel durumunu veya bu durumun iyileştirilmesini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kökten türeyen birden fazla biçimin kişilere ad olarak verildiğini ve bunlardan birinin bir peygamberin adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir. Geçici çerçeve ad kullanımını sıradan bir kişilik niteliğinden ayırdığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca kök türevlerinin kişi adı olarak kullanılmasını kapsar; aynı biçimlerin iyi ve düzgün kimseyi nitelemesi ayrı anlamdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalda kişi adı olarak kalıplaşmış biçimlerle sınırlıdır; genel niteleme, yer adı veya başka ad türleri bu dala katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Salih, Suleyh ve Muslih biçimlerinin kişilere özel ad olarak verilmesidir; Salih ayrıca bir peygamber adıdır.

facets.statement: Salih, Suleyh ve Muslih biçimleri kişilere özel ad olarak verilir.
Salih bu kişi adları içinde ayrıca bir peygamberin özel adıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, aynı kökten türeyen çeşitli biçimlerin kişi adı olarak kullanıldığını ve bunlardan birinin ayrıca bir peygamberi adlandırdığını bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kökten türeyen biçimlerin niteleme değil özel kişi adı olarak kullanıldığı bütün bu dalı temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Birden çok kök türevinin kişi adı olmasını ve ad kullanımının özel sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Biçimlerin anlamlı bir niteleme olarak değil kişilere verilmiş özel adlar olarak anıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kökten türeme ile kişi adı işlevini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bu kökten türemiş kişi adları; bunlardan biri bir peygamber adıdır

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda biçim kişiyi tanıtan özel addır ve bir nitelik ileri sürmez; komşu dalda ise kişinin iyi ve düzgün olduğu bildirilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın göndergeleri insanlardır; komşu dalın göndergeleri ise bir kent ve bir nehirdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca bu kökten türeyen belirli kişi adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal farklı bir kökten gelen çeşitli kişi ve yer adlarını birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: aynı kökten kişi adları ve çeşitli özel adlar
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sıradan sözlük anlamından ayrılmış özel ad kullanımlarını toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı kökten gelen ayrı biçimlerden birini belirli bir kentin, ötekini belirli bir nehrin adı olarak tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve bu iki yer adı kullanımını kişiler arası barışma ve genel düzgünlük anlamlarından ayırdığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca iki biçimin belirli bir kent ve nehir için özel ad olmasını kapsar; kişi adları ile sıradan sözlük anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalda belirli yerleri adlandıran iki özel ad kullanımıyla sınırlıdır; genel yer adı anlamı veya sıradan nitelik anlamı çıkarılamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi örtmeyi, örtülen şeyi kirden ya da zarardan korumayı ve başlık, bez, bulut, kap ile ilgili özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte destekler. Bu nedenle dalın koruyarak örtme çerçevesi kaynak anlamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği fiziksel ya da işlevsel örtme ve korumadır; suçun bağışlanması, hastalığın kötüleşmesi ve öteki eş adlı anlamlar buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak örtme çekirdeği ile başlık, bez, bulut ve belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi örterek görünürlükten, kirden ya da zarardan korumak ve bu işi gören örtü veya koruyucu katmanı belirtmektir. Bazı kullanımlar, eşyayı kaba koyma ya da bir işi gereken biçimde örtüp düzeltme gibi belirli yapılara bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
Başı koruyan zırh başlığı, başörtüsünü yağdan sakınan bez, yay çentiğindeki yama ve başka bir bulutu örten bulut bu çekirdeğin özel örnekleridir.
Eşyayı bir kaba koyma, kumaşı kiri daha iyi gizler duruma getirme ve bir işi uygun biçimde örtüp düzeltme yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ile korumayı ortak çekirdek sayar; koruyucu başlık ve çeşitli bez ya da örtü türleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırırken kap, kumaş ve iş düzenleme kullanımları belirli yapılara bağlı kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtme işlemi ile örtülen şeyi koruma sonucunun birlikte bulunduğu genel çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem örtme işlemini hem de kir, zarar veya görünürlük karşısındaki koruyucu işlevi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatma eyleminin aynı zamanda onu koruduğu fiil bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirdekteki örtme işlemini ve bunun koruyucu sonucunu birlikte verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Baş, kumaş, yay çentiği ya da benzeri bir yüzey üstündeki koruyucu nesne anlatılırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün koruma işlevini ve üstte duran katman olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Eylem anlamını ve yalnızca belirli söz yapılarında görülen kap ya da düzeltme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Örtmenin nesneyi kirden ya da zarardan koruma amacı ve belirli koruyucu nesneleri öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin üstüne konan her türlü örtüyü, koruma sonucu zorunlu olmadan daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında örtme ile koruyup sakınma bağı kurucudur; komşu dalda ise üstünü kapatma yeterlidir ve koruyucu sonuç zorunlu değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koruyucu başlık, bez ve benzeri araçlarda örtmenin nesneyi korumasını özellikle içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Duyudan gizlenmeyi, kişinin bir şeyle saklanmasını ve içte saklanan düşünceyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı bir şeyi görünürlükten çıkaran örtme işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı koruyan bir örtüyü ve koruma sonucunu öne çıkarır; komşu dal gizlenme ve içte saklama yönünde daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Somut ya da işlevsel bir örtüyle nesneyi kirden, zarardan veya görünürlükten korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir suçu bağışlayıp kişiyi cezanın etkisinden koruyan ahlaki ve dinsel işlemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da olumsuz bir etkinin kişiye ya da nesneye ulaşmasını önleme düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının çekirdeği örtme eylemidir; komşu dalda konu suç ve cezadır, fiziksel bir örtü kurucu anlam taşımaz.
